questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The first screen reads as a perks overview ('Monthly Growing CarouBiz', a list of benefits); pausing is just one of two buttons.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Pause subscription' is a filled dark button right beside the filled teal 'Manage subscription', so two buttons compete and a disruptive action has primary-level weight.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Manage subscription' and 'Pause subscription' say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '3.00x the listing quota', 'Spotlight CoinsBack 0/3000' and 'Unlimited reply quota' assume the seller knows how quotas and CoinsBack work.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only whether to manage or pause, which the subscriber can decide.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Every perk is listed with a description line ('Use them to buy Bumps, Spotlights…'), all up front rather than behind a 'view benefits' link.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Plan status, perks and pause all belong to managing a subscription.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The buttons are near the top, but the long perks list with a sentence under each fills the rest of the screen.
